info.title: Kadé gateway-customer
info.description: Backend-for-frontend REST API for the Kadé customer app. Shapes match apps/customer/src/api/types.ts. Money is whole rupees (LKR); instants are epoch milliseconds; restaurant ids are the app's numbers. Errors are application/problem+json with a stable `code`. Mutations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Realtime: WebSocket /ws, proxied to the realtime service (see the gateway README).

id.description: The app's restaurant number (seeded UUID suffix).

closedLabel.description: Present while closed, e.g. "Opens at 8 am".

cardId.description: Saved card id (requests); the app sends brand/last4.

choices.description: Chosen option names, in menu order.

id.description: Order number, e.g. "KD-4821" (falls back to the UUID).

dueAt.description: Latest time promised to the customer.

expectedTotal.description: The total the customer saw; PRICE_CHANGED if the server's differs.

phone.description: National format without the leading 0, e.g. "771234567".

isNew.description: First sign-in (or no name yet): ask for a name.

pspUrl.description: PSP hosted-fields endpoint; empty in dev (fake PSP).

joinsAfter.description: ms after createdAt that this person joined
